CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_tester_report_financial_metadata()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
begin
    -- Security invoker: discriminates current_user 'authenticated'/'anon' for direct client DML
    -- vs trusted SECURITY DEFINER RPCs where current_user is the function owner (postgres).
    if current_user in ('anon', 'authenticated') then
        if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
            if new.review_tester_bonus is not null or
               new.review_owner_bonus is not null or
               new.business_policy_id is not null or
               coalesce(new.provisional_granted_credits, 0) <> 0 or
               coalesce(new.provisional_clawed, 0) <> 0 or
               coalesce(new.bonus_awarded, 0) <> 0 then
                raise exception 'FORBIDDEN_REPORT_METADATA_WRITE: Chi duoc tao bao cao qua RPC nop bao cao';
            end if;
        elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
            if new.review_tester_bonus is distinct from old.review_tester_bonus or
               new.review_owner_bonus is distinct from old.review_owner_bonus or
               new.business_policy_id is distinct from old.business_policy_id or
               new.provisional_granted_credits is distinct from old.provisional_granted_credits or
               new.provisional_clawed is distinct from old.provisional_clawed or
               new.bonus_awarded is distinct from old.bonus_awarded then
                raise exception 'FORBIDDEN_REPORT_METADATA_UPDATE: Khong duoc phep sua doi thong so tai chinh cua bao cao';
            end if;
        end if;
    end if;
    return new;
end;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_guard_tester_report_financial_metadata ON public.tester_reports;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_tester_report_financial_metadata
    BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.tester_reports
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_tester_report_financial_metadata();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_home_feed()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
    v_today date := (clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
    v_period_start date;
    v_open jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_paused jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_completed jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_owner_names jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
    v_stats jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
begin
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(public._campaign_json(c) order by c.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_open
    from public.campaigns c
    where c.status = 'open';

    if v_uid is not null then
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(public._campaign_json(c) order by c.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
        into v_paused
        from public.campaigns c
        where c.status = 'paused';

        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(public._campaign_json(c) order by c.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
        into v_completed
        from public.campaigns c
        where c.status in ('production', 'completed');
    end if;

    select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(t.owner_id::text, t.name), '{}'::jsonb)
    into v_owner_names
    from (
        select distinct c.owner_id,
               coalesce(nullif(p.display_name, ''), split_part(coalesce(p.email, ''), '@', 1), 'Chá»§ app') as name
        from public.campaigns c
        left join public.profiles p on p.id = c.owner_id
        where c.status = 'open'
           or (v_uid is not null and c.status in ('paused', 'production', 'completed'))
    ) t;

    -- XÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh má»‘c Ä‘áº§u chu ká»³ hiá»‡n táº¡i
    select period_start into v_period_start from public._get_home_stats_period(v_today);

    select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(s.id::text, jsonb_build_object(
        'installed_count', coalesce(s.installed_count, 0),
        'today_tested_count', coalesce(s.today_tested_count, 0),
        'has_tested_today', coalesce(s.has_tested_today, false),
        'home_tested_count', coalesce(s.home_tested_count, 0),
        'stats_date', v_today::text
    )), '{}'::jsonb)
    into v_stats
    from (
        select c.id,
            (select count(*) from public.campaign_members m where m.campaign_id = c.id) as installed_count,
            (select count(distinct ci.user_id) from public.checkins ci
              where ci.campaign_id = c.id and ci.checkin_date = v_today) as today_tested_count,
            (select count(*) from public.checkins ci_period
              where ci_period.campaign_id = c.id
                and ci_period.checkin_date >= v_period_start
                and ci_period.checkin_date <= v_today) as home_tested_count,
            (v_uid is not null and (
                exists (select 1 from public.checkins ci2
                        where ci2.campaign_id = c.id and ci2.user_id = v_uid and ci2.checkin_date = v_today)
                or exists (select 1 from public.tester_reports tr
                           where tr.campaign_id = c.id and tr.user_id = v_uid
                             and coalesce(tr.submission_context, 'app_test') = 'app_test'

Do not weaken existing tests to match an older copied core.
- Parent captured actual 062..086 function definitions from native PostgreSQL in `baseline-functions/`; use these to compare latest semantics without repeatedly opening the enormous baseline migration.

## Confirmed native PostgreSQL deadlock

Parent installed and started a real PostgreSQL 17.11 test cluster; see LOCAL_POSTGRES_READY.md. 087 applies successfully to that isolated database. This is NOT a PGlite simulation.

Run: `node audit/tester-bonus-2026-11-11/review-native-probes.mjs --round-close`.

Result: lifecycle succeeded, simultaneous owner round-close RPC failed `40P01: deadlock detected`.

Controlled real interleaving:
1. Transaction A holds campaign row FOR UPDATE, as a lifecycle row update necessarily does.
2. Transaction B executes actual close_campaign_tester_bonus RPC. It locks the round, then waits to update campaign summary (blocked by A).
3. A sets campaign status completed. Its row trigger synchronously calls close/refund, waiting on B's round lock.
4. Cycle: campaign->round vs round->campaign. PostgreSQL detects a deadlock.

Fix lock acquisition/closing architecture, not retries or test skips. A queue/deferred closing worker that does not lock rounds while the lifecycle transaction holds campaign rows is one possible approach; document the ACTUAL consistent lock order in LOCK_ORDER.md. Plain SKIP LOCKED only in the batch loop does not fix the synchronous lifecycle trigger inversion. Ordinary lifecycle-vs-approval probe happened to pass in one interleaving; this does not negate the confirmed round-close cycle.

- Current guard throws on any unsettled bonus round. Admin delete first closes then raises if pending; raising rolls back the closing state too. A guard alone is not the plan's required deletion lifecycle: stop new eligibility, preserve pending obligations, process them, refund, and complete removal without dropping financial evidence.

Returning a pending-removal result can be acceptable if old/new clients are handled coherently, campaign no longer accepts new reports, pending reports remain reviewable/auto-accepted, and a job actually completes deletion after settlement. ## API contract documentation must match SQL

## 1. Overview & Business Rules

This contract defines the communication interfaces for the **Campaign Tester Bonus Rounds** feature (Plan `KE_HOACH_THUONG_THEM_CHO_TESTER_2026-11-11.md`).

### Authorized Business Defaults
1. **Settlement Mechanism:** "First eligible approvals/award transactions" (NOT first submissions). Testers who submit reports qualify for bonus snapshot attachment, but awards are granted in order of report approval (manual by owner or 8h auto-acceptance) until capacity is exhausted.
2. **Escrow & Budget:** The campaign owner prepays the full budget (`reward_credits * max_recipients`) into escrow at round creation. There is zero additional platform service fee.
3. **Tester Quota:** Strictly at most 1 bonus award per distinct tester per round.
4. **Duration & Reset:** No midnight reset. The round persists until remaining slots reach 0 (`exhausted`), or the owner closes it, or the campaign lifecycle ends (`completed`, `production`, `closed`).
5. **Base Rewards Preserved:** Exhausted rounds still permit ordinary report submissions and approvals with base rewards (+2 manual review bonus). Legacy tips and missions remain completely separate.

All RPCs are defined in schema `public`, execute with `SECURITY DEFINER` and a strict schema-qualified `search_path = public, auth, extensions`, and are accessible only to authenticated clients.

# Documenting Lock Acquisition Order for Campaign Tester Bonus Rounds

> **Date:** 2026-11-11  
> **Status:** Formalized & Deadlock-Free Hierarchy  
> **Architecture Goal:** Prevent deadlocks across concurrent report approvals, 8h auto-accept, owner round closures, lifecycle status updates, and admin campaign deletions.

---

## 1. Existing System Locking Patterns & Deadlock Analysis

### Prior Inversion Observed During Native Probes:
In a concurrent execution between a campaign lifecycle transition (e.g. `UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'completed'`) and an owner's RPC call `close_campaign_tester_bonus(campaign_id)`:
1. **Transaction A (Lifecycle):** The `UPDATE campaigns` query automatically acquires an exclusive row lock on the `campaigns` table row. Its `AFTER UPDATE` row trigger synchronously executed a helper that attempted to lock the bonus round (`campaign_tester_bonus_rounds FOR UPDATE`).
2. **Transaction B (Round Close):** The RPC executed `SELECT ... FROM campaign_tester_bonus_rounds FOR UPDATE` (acquiring the round lock first), and then executed an `UPDATE campaigns SET tester_bonus_status = ...` (attempting to acquire the campaign row lock).
3. **Deadlock Result:** Transaction A held `campaigns` and waited for `rounds`. Transaction B held `rounds` and waited for `campaigns`. PostgreSQL caught this bidirectional wait and threw `40P01: deadlock detected`.

---

## 2. Formal 6-Level Unidirectional Lock Hierarchy

To guarantee mathematical impossibility of deadlock cycles, all transactions touching multiple resources must acquire locks in strictly ascending hierarchy order:

```
[Level 1: Advisory Locks]
       â”‚
       â–¼
[Level 2: tester_reports]
       â”‚
       â–¼
[Level 3: campaigns]
       â”‚
       â–¼
[Level 4: campaign_tester_bonus_rounds]
       â”‚
       â–¼
[Level 5: profiles (wallet credits)]
       â”‚
       â–¼
[Level 6: Leaf Append-Only Tables]
(credit_logs, notifications, events, awards, receipts)
```

### Hierarchy Rules:
1. **Strict Upward Flow:** A transaction holding a resource at Level $K$ may ONLY acquire resources at Level $L$ where $L > K$. It may **never** acquire a resource at Level $J \le K$.
2. **Campaign Before Round Rule:** Any operation that modifies or coordinates both a `campaign` and its `campaign_tester_bonus_rounds` MUST acquire the row lock on `campaigns` (Level 3) **before** acquiring the row lock on `campaign_tester_bonus_rounds` (Level 4).
3. **Asynchronous / Deferred Lifecycle:** The row trigger `trg_campaigns_bonus_round_lifecycle` on `campaigns` never calls synchronous refund/payout helpers. It solely marks the active round as `closing` via a single-row update on Level 4. Full closing and refund are processed asynchronously by the background scanner `_process_closing_tester_bonus_rounds()` or upon settlement of the last pending report.

---

## 3. Lock Sequences for Core Database Operations

### 3.1. `close_campaign_tester_bonus(p_campaign_id)`
```
1. [Level 3] SELECT id, owner_id FROM public.campaigns WHERE id = p_campaign_id FOR UPDATE;
2. [Level 4] SELECT id FROM public.campaign_tester_bonus_rounds WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id AND status IN ('active', 'closing') FOR UPDATE;
3. Count pending reports on round (Level 2 read-only MVCC, no lock held).
4. If pending = 0:
   - [Level 5] UPDATE public.profiles SET credits = credits + refund WHERE id = round.owner_id;
   - [Level 6] INSERT INTO credit_logs, campaign_tester_bonus_events, notifications;
   - [Level 4] UPDATE campaign_tester_bonus_rounds SET status = 'closed', remaining_credits = 0;
   - [Level 3] UPDATE campaigns SET tester_bonus_status = 'closed', tester_bonus_round_id = null;
5. If pending > 0:
   - [Level 4] UPDATE campaign_tester_bonus_rounds SET status = 'closing';
   - [Level 3] UPDATE campaigns SET tester_bonus_status = 'closing';
```
*Result:* Holds Level 3 before Level 4. Never deadlocks with lifecycle updates.

### 3.2. Lifecycle Update (`UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'completed' | 'production' | 'closed'`)
```
1. [Level 3] PostgreSQL acquires row lock on campaigns row during UPDATE.
2. [Trigger BEFORE/AFTER] Updates active round:
   [Level 4] UPDATE public.campaign_tester_bonus_rounds SET status = 'closing' WHERE campaign_id = new.id AND status = 'active';
   [Level 3] new.tester_bonus_status := 'closing', new.tester_bonus_remaining_slots := 0;
```
*Result:* Locks Level 3, then Level 4. No synchronous calls into profiles or tester_reports. Never deadlocks.

1. [Level 2] SELECT * FROM public.tester_reports WHERE id = p_report_id FOR UPDATE;
2. [Level 3] SELECT id, owner_id FROM public.campaigns WHERE id = v_report.campaign_id FOR UPDATE;

### Hoàn thành Milestone 1 (Backend & API Contract)

Triển khai toàn bộ mã nguồn backend và tài liệu giao kết cho tính năng **Đợt Thưởng Thêm Cho Tester (Campaign Tester Bonus Rounds)** theo kế hoạch `KE_HOACH_THUONG_THEM_CHO_TESTER_2026-11-11.md`.

---

### 1. Danh mục Tệp Đã Tạo & Cập Nhật

- [`supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql):
  - **Bảng dữ liệu & Sổ cái:** [`campaign_tester_bonus_rounds`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L43-L84), [`campaign_tester_bonus_awards`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L101-L125) (bổ sung `owner_id`), [`campaign_tester_bonus_events`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L137-L157) (bổ sung `owner_id`).
  - **Bất biến bảo toàn ngân sách:** Ràng buộc `reserved_credits = remaining_credits + spent_credits + refunded_credits`, `spent_credits = reward_credits * paid_count`, `reserved_credits = reward_credits * max_recipients`.
  - **Snapshot & Summary:** Cột `tester_bonus_round_id` và `tester_bonus_awarded` trên `tester_reports`; summary fields trên `campaigns`.
  - **Bảo mật RLS & Chống can thiệp:** Kích hoạt RLS, cô lập quyền đọc cho chủ app/admin và tester của giải thưởng; trigger chống client ghi trực tiếp [`trg_campaigns_guard_financial_snapshots`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L243-L330) và [`trg_campaigns_guard_tester_bonus_before_delete`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L1294-L1318).
  - **RPCs Công khai:**
    - [`create_campaign_tester_bonus`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L433-L640): Ký quỹ 100% ngân sách từ `profiles.credits`, chống tràn số nguyên bigint, khóa advisory kiểm tra idempotent replay trước khi xét điều kiện tạo mới.
    - [`reconcile_campaign_tester_bonus`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L652-L715): Đọc an toàn kết quả request của chủ app mà không tạo mới request.
    - [`get_campaign_tester_bonus`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L727-L815): Phân tách Owner view (chi tiết tài chính) và Tester view (ẩn số dư ví, ẩn ledger nội bộ).
    - [`close_campaign_tester_bonus`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L1212-L1287): Đóng đợt thưởng và chuyển sang `closing`.
  - **Tích hợp Vòng đời & Quyết toán:**
    - [`_submit_tester_report_core`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L1457-L2080): Gắn snapshot đợt thưởng duy nhất cho báo cáo `app_test` mới, bảo toàn tiền điều kiện ngày (`REPORT_DATE_MISMATCH`), finalized mission và multi-attachment.
    - [`_settle_campaign_tester_bonus`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L818-L998): Quyết toán tuần tự suất thưởng theo thứ tự duyệt báo cáo, bảo đảm tối đa 1 giải/tester/đợt thưởng. Tách bạch `tester_bonus_awarded` khỏi tip/nhiệm vụ.
    - Duyệt thủ công ([`_impl_approve_tester_report`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L2265-L2425)) và tự động sau 8h ([`auto_accept_expired_reports`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L2440-L2590)).
    - Quyết toán hoãn hủy admin delete ([`_impl_admin_delete_campaign`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L1336-L1445)) và quét batch định kỳ ([`_process_closing_tester_bonus_rounds`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L1173-L1210)).
    - Invalidation Egress Sync V2 trên [`_campaign_json`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/supabase/migrations/087_campaign_tester_bonus_rounds.sql#L340-L425).
- [`LOCK_ORDER.md`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/LOCK_ORDER.md): Thứ bậc 6 cấp khóa đơn hướng (`L1 Advisory -> L2 tester_reports -> L3 campaigns -> L4 campaign_tester_bonus_rounds -> L5 profiles -> L6 leaf ledgers/logs`). Cố định quy tắc `campaigns` (L3) luôn khóa trước `rounds` (L4), hóa giải hoàn toàn chu kỳ deadlock giữa lifecycle transition và round closure.
- [`API_CONTRACT.md`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/API_CONTRACT.md): Tài liệu đặc tả DTOs Kotlin và chữ ký RPC cho Milestone Android, khớp 100% với dữ liệu và mã lỗi trả về từ SQL.
- [`BACKEND_RESULT.md`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/BACKEND_RESULT.md): Báo cáo chi tiết các tệp, lệnh kiểm thử và quy trình rollout/rollback.
- [`PROGRESS.md`](file:///F:/AI/12Tester/PROGRESS.md): Cập nhật tiến độ hoàn thành Milestone 1.
